question: With which of the following sports is Lovlina Borgohain associated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**boxing**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lovlina Borgohain** is associated with the sport of **boxing**.
 
• She is an Indian boxer who has made significant contributions to the sport.
 
• Lovlina has represented India in various international competitions and has won several medals.
 
• She gained widespread recognition for her performance in the **Tokyo 2020 Olympics**, where she won a bronze medal in the women's welterweight category.
 
• Her achievements have made her a prominent figure in Indian sports, especially in boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Lovlina Borgohain was born on **2nd October 1997** in the **Golaghat district of Assam**, India.
 
• She started her boxing career at a young age and quickly rose through the ranks due to her talent and hard work.
 
• She has been honored with several awards, including the prestigious **Arjuna Award** for her contributions to boxing.
 
• Lovlina continues to inspire many young athletes in India, particularly those aspiring to pursue a career in boxing.
